chapter: Bay St. Louis roots and early music
title: Instrumentation of his father's Promo brass band
summary: Labat lists the pieces in the Promo society brass band: trumpets, baritone, bass, drums, trombones; no clarinet.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: I guess about, let me see, they had two trumpets, three trumpets, one baritone, one bass, snag drum, bass drum, and two trombones. How many pieces? How many pieces you didn't come to? I didn't come to that. That's about eight. Did you say tuba or no?
Yeah, tuba. What kind of, they had a clarinet?
